== Overview ==
It is enshrined in the center of the Tago district, on high ground (Ainoura) just south of Ōtago Beach.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with the similarly named {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} Tago Shrine (たごじんじゃ), and is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|ja|伊豆国神階帳|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Tago no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/tago_title.htm 哆胡神社] - Genbu</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140309-01.html 多胡神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

Originally it stood in the northern Ōtago district as Hachiman Shrine, but in 1881 ({{ill|1881|ab|1881|af|1881|als|1881|am|1881 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1881|ar|1881|ary|1881|arz|1881|ast|1881|avk|1881|az|1881|azb|۱۸۸۱ (میلادی)|ba|1881 йыл|ban|1881|bar|1881|bat_smg|1881|bcl|1881|be|1881|be_x_old|1881|bg|1881|bn|১৮৮১|bpy|মারি ১৮৮১|br|1881|bs|1881.|ca|1881|cdo|1881 nièng|ce|1881 шо|ceb|1881|ckb|١٨٨١|co|1881|crh|1881|cs|1881|csb|1881|cv|1881|cy|1881|da|1881|de|1881|diq|1881|el|1881|eml|1881|eo|1881|es|1881|et|1881|eu|1881|fa|۱۸۸۱|fi|1881|fiu_vro|1881|fo|1881|fr|1881|frp|1881|frr|1881|fur|1881|fy|1881|ga|1881|gan|1881年|gcr|1881|gd|1881|gl|1881|gn|1881|gv|1881|hak|1881-ngièn|he|1881|hi|१८८१|hif|1881|hr|1881.|hsb|1881|ht|1881 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1881|hy|1881|hyw|1881 թուական|ia|1881|id|1881|ilo|1881|io|1881|is|1881|it|1881|ja|1881年|jv|1881|ka|1881|kaa|1881|kk|1881 жыл|kn|೧೮೮೧|ko|1881년|krc|1881 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1881|ku|1881|kv|1881-ӧд во|la|1881|lb|1881|lez|1881 йис|li|1881|lij|1881|lld|1881|lmo|1881|lt|1881 m.|lv|1881. gads|mai|१८८१|map_bms|1881|mdf|1881|mg|1881|mhr|1881|mi|1881|min|1881|mk|1881|ml|1881|mr|इ.स. १८८१|mrj|1881 и|ms|1881|my|၁၈၈၁|myv|1881 ие|mzn|۱۸۸۱|nah|1881|nap|1881|nds|1881|nds_nl|1881|new|ई सं १८८१|nl|1881|nn|1881|no|1881|nrm|1881|nso|1881|oc|1881|olo|1881|or|୧୮୮୧|os|1881-æм аз|pa|1881|pap|1881|pl|1881|pnb|1881|pt|1881|qu|1881|ro|1881|ru|1881 год|rue|1881|sa|१८८१|sah|1881|sc|1881|scn|1881|sd|1881ع|se|1881|sh|1881.|shn|1881|si|1881|simple|1881|sk|1881|sl|1881|smn|1881|sq|1881|sr|1881|stq|1881|su|1881|sv|1881|sw|1881|szl|1881|ta|1881|te|1881|tet|1881|tg|Соли 1881|th|พ.ศ. 2424|tk|1881|tl|1881|tly|1881|tr|1881|tt|1881 ел|udm|1881 ар|uk|1881|ur|1881ء|uz|1881|vec|1881|vi|1881|vls|1881|vo|1881|wa|1881|war|1881|wuu|1881年|xmf|1881|yi|1881|za|1881 nienz|zea|1881|zh|1881年|zh_classical|一八八一年|zh_min_nan|1881 nî|zh_yue|1881年|qid=Q7808}}, Meiji 14) it was merged with Mishima Shrine of the southern Itago district and moved to its present location<ref name="engi"/>.
